statements.proposition: This change modifies bulk_raw_query so that it becomes a wrapper calling a new internal helper _bulk_raw_query_to_snuba_queries.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: bulk_raw_query is byte-identical at base and head, and no function named _bulk_raw_query_to_snuba_queries exists at head. The change instead adds a public helper convert_snuba_params_to_requests and migrates callers (raw_query, preview.py, executors.py, eventstore backend, tests) from bulk_raw_query to bulk_snuba_queries.

statements.proposition: This change makes no changes to the public API or behaviour of the affected code.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Static check, not run (Sentry tests need Snuba/Postgres services). Previously raw_query and the migrated callers went through bulk_raw_query, which builds SnubaRequest with the forward/reverse translators from get_snuba_translators; the reverse translator is applied to every result row (body['data'] = [reverse(d) ...]) and, among other things, converts 'time' and 'bucketed_end' columns to integer timestamps and maps snuba keys back to model ids. The new path convert_snuba_params_to_requests + bulk_snuba_queries discards forward/reverse and uses identity lambdas, so result rows are no longer reverse-translated. Also a new public function convert_snuba_params_to_requests is added to the module API (additive). The behaviour claim is therefore contradicted by the code.
